sources.title: 7err4/MOSS-Image-CharRef · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Reference (left) → three new scenes, CharRef v2 at 1.0, MOSS-Image full mode (50 steps, cfg 3, sgm_uniform, SLG single layer 22), 832×1216, prompt = prefix + scene tags + appearance words. No cherry-picking: one seed per scene. ai-toolkit edit mode (arch: moss_image, edit: true, kv_cache: true), LoRA rank 32 / alpha 32, AdamW8bit 1e-4, batch 1, 1000 steps, 1024 px, MOSS-Image Base bf16.

sources.title: pleiades7/MOSS-Image-CharRef-PoC · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The reference's art style usually comes out more like MOSS's default anime look. Early experiment: small dataset, short training, very little testing. Not tuned or evaluated beyond a few examples. Trainer: AI Toolkit, MOSS-Image Base in edit mode (edit, kv_cache, match_target_res, block 22 skipped on the negative branch).

sources.snippet: MOSS-Image is the latest image generation model developed by the OpenMOSS team. The OpenMOSS team is a research group established by three parties: Fudan University, the Shanghai Innovation Institute (SII), and MOSI Intelligence. They have released many AI models in addition to MOSS-Image.
